in_marathi.name: Chandrabhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon (Chandra) and Bhanu (Sun)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrabhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chandrabhan is a combination of two words - Chandra (Moon) and Bhanu (Sun). This name is derived from Hindu mythology, where the Moon is considered the god of knowledge and the Sun is the god of energy and strength. Therefore, Chandrabhan can be understood as one who possesses both wisdom and power.
